posts.author: TenDev
posts.body:
I’M PLANNING TO MAKE AN MMO ONLINE PLUGIN FOR RPG MAKER MV
Hey everyone using RPG Maker MV! I’m a dev and I’m working on a plan to make an MMO Online plugin – something that’ll let you turn your RPG Maker MV game into a real online multiplayer experience.
Planned features:
Chat
Trading and player-to-player item exchange
PVP (player killing)
ABS (action battle system)
And literally any other features you want (as long as they can be coded, I’ll put them in)
The plugin will be optimized, no bullshit, just pure performance and easy to use.
I’m not promising a release date yet, but I’ll do my best. Anyone with ideas, feedback, or who wants to join in and help build it, drop a comment below.
That’s the plan. I’ll update as soon as I make progress. If you’re interested, throw in your two cents or join the ride.

posts.author: ZimXero
posts.body:
Personally,
I think a modular option might be popular.  What I mean is, the maker creates a HUB world or city that brings characters up to level 10 or so.  Other makers can link there own maps, dungeons, or quests to the main world.  The linkage would require permission or approval of the main hub game owner.
I have no idea how it would be done on the programming side.  Maybe each offshoot module is given reserved database space ahead of time and assets are designated as public or private, and each module has it's own credits.

posts.author: TenDev
posts.body: I’m using Node.js, MongoDB, and Colyseus to build the server. I’m setting up something simple so that users can just download it without needing much coding knowledge.
